name: Tsukubamirai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsukubamirai city emblem in blue, green and red: a blue stylised swirl above a green oval, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Tsukubamirai, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 27 March 2006.

features.role: Tsukubamirai city emblem — a blue stylised swirl above a green oval, with a red disc
